themes.name: Agentic AI applications
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform tasks, manage processes, and interact with systems, often highlighting their impact on business operations and software development.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, including discussions on their effectiveness, security, and integration into workflows.

themes.name: AI for design and research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI can be integrated into the design process and user research activities, from generating design elements to informing research strategies.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare, evaluate, or provide insights into various AI tools specifically designed for research purposes, including their features and performance.

themes.name: AI in media generation
themes.description: Content related to AI's role in creating synthetic media, such as fake photos, AI actors, and AI-written scripts, and the implications for industries and value perception.

themes.name: AI for user experience
themes.description: Articles that examine how AI can be applied to enhance user experience, from improving dating apps to addressing usability and accessibility in human-AI interactions.

themes.name: AI chatbot accuracy
themes.description: Discussions on the accuracy and potential negative impacts of AI chatbots, including their tendency to make errors or influence user behavior negatively.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles related to the application of AI in automating testing processes, particularly for software and AI systems themselves.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content that addresses the effects of AI on employment, job security, and the skills required in the workforce, including concerns and potential shifts.

themes.name: AI-generated content security
themes.description: Discussions surrounding security risks associated with AI-generated content, including attacks like slopsquatting and the bypass of safety filters through identity-framing.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
